comments.author: dominicjj
comments.why_zh: 从头用公式创作一个女孩的自拍
comments.quote_zh: 在这里从头用公式创作一个女孩的自拍
comments.text_zh: 这些 demo 几乎都是在运行时生成并显示的。音乐由运行时通过 additive synthesis 生成的采样组成，说到底就是把不同频率的波形加在一起。不需要很多行代码就能做出 CD 品质的乐器，并编排成配乐。如今的 64k intro 利用 shader 和一种叫 raymarching 的技术，把绘制工作卸载到 GPU 上；raymarching 是一种固定步长的 raytracing，可以实时完成。本质上，你看到的物体是用数学“画”出来的：3D 分形或复杂物体不再需要成千上万个顶点，而是把一个公式喂给 ray marcher，它返回一个带有颜色和光照的形状。然后通过并集和交集组合形状，而且形状公式通常还会把时间作为参数。想自己玩这个概念，可以去 [LINK] 看看 shader 程序如何用少得惊人的代码行渲染出令人惊叹的场景。想很好地了解创作过程，可以看 raymarching 的祖师爷 Inigo Quilez 在这里从头用公式创作一个女孩的自拍：[VIDEO]
comments.text: Demos are almost always generated and displayed at runtime. The music is composed of samples generated at runtime by additive synthesis which is just adding waveforms of differing frequencies together when you get down to it. It doesn't take many lines of code to produce CD quality instruments that can be arranged as a soundtrack. Today's 64k intros offload their drawing onto the GPU using shaders and a technique called raymarching which is a form of fixed-step raytracing that can be done in real time. Essentially the objects you see are painted with math: instead of thousands of vertices for a 3d fractal or a complex object, a formula is fed in to the ray marcher and it returns a shape with colors and lighting. Combining shapes using unions and intersections is then done and often the shape formula will take time as a parameter as well. To play with this concept yourself go to [LINK] and see how shader programs are rendered into incredible scenes with astonishingly few lines of code. For a wonderful look at the creation process, see the grandfather of raymarching Inigo Quilez create a selfie of a girl from scratch using formulas here: [VIDEO]
